query: UPDATE mail_items SET status_json=?,status_version=?,result_json=?,submit_attempted_at=COALESCE(submit_attempted_at,?),terminal_at=?,item_json=CASE WHEN ? THEN NULL ELSE item_json END,projection_json=CASE WHEN ? THEN NULL ELSE projection_json END,payload_bytes=CASE WHEN ? THEN 0 ELSE payload_bytes END WHERE item_id=?
